app.title: Guitar amp and effects pedal built on the Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-2.06
app.author: arbayi
app.description: Firmware for a guitar amp and effects pedal running on the Waveshare ESP32‑S3‑Touch‑AMOLED‑2.06 board.
proposed_tests: Clone the repository and verify the Makefile builds the firmware.
Flash the built firmware onto an ESP32‑S3 board and confirm it powers on.
Run a test signal through the amp to ensure the audio output is audible and distortion is within acceptable limits.
Apply a preset effects chain via the OLED UI and record output to validate DSP processing.
Measure firmware boot time and memory usage with a serial monitor.
